changes: FIX-01: Major provenance & attribution errors in Chapters 5-6 (S20, S21, S22, S23): (a) S21's 1997 Cariaco, Venezuela school desk collapse photos are falsely attributed to the American Red Cross in sources[20], ch5, and K153-0113 (they were actually taken by the UPRM Civil Engineering Strong Motion Program); (b) ECA's 4 verbatim wrong assumptions on S21 are misstated (item #2 is 'collapsing buildings always crush all furniture inside', not 'sliding heavy appliances', which comes from UPRM commentary & USGS Related FAQ); (c) S20's main FAQ answer is only two sentences — detailed pancake-collapse/flying-debris/moving-furniture claims over-attributed to S20 in sources[19] & K153-0113 actually come from S21 and S20's Related FAQ snippets; (d) '至少三天份' / '三天份' of emergency water and food in sources[21] (S22), ch6, K153-0117, and K153-0118 is fabricated from memory — S22 only writes '儲存備用糧食飲水' (no day count) and S23 writes 'several days'; S22 also does not contain the collapse-direction/sliding-furniture text attributed to it; (e) S23 Ready.gov only says 'avoid doorways' and 'do not run outside' (without 'modern doorways no stronger / pinched fingers' or 'exterior tiles/signboards') and instructs holding shelter with ONE hand while covering head/neck with the other (not '雙手緊抓桌腳' in ch6 & K153-0116). → Correct all attributions across sources[19..22], ch5, ch6, K153-0113, K153-0115, K153-0116, K153-0117, and K153-0118: credit the 1997 Cariaco school photos to 波多黎各大學馬亞圭斯校區地震工程勘災實拍 (keeping living professor name out of viewer copy); list ECA's exact 4 assumptions alongside UPRM/USGS warnings on sliding appliances; trim S20 & S22 summaries to what those pages actually state; replace '三天份' with '數日份備用飲水與糧食' (or add an official Taiwan NFA booklet URL that explicitly prints 三天份); tighten doorway/outdoor rationale to match S23/S20 or cite a primary source; and align Hold On wording with S23 ('一手護住頭頸、一手緊抓桌腳' / '穩住桌腳').

FIX-02: Unsupported '美日台' (US-Japan-Taiwan) claim in Chapters 5-6: theme.core_question, ch5.title, ch6.title, K153-0113.question, and K153-0116.answer_target claim Japanese officials refuted Triangle of Life and endorsed Drop-Cover-Hold On, yet ZERO Japanese sources in G817 cover Chapters 5-6 (S10, S15, S16 only cover liquefaction and long-period skyscraper swaying). → Either replace all 5 '美日台' occurrences with '美台官方' / '國際與台灣防災機構', OR add a verified official Japanese disaster-agency source (e.g., Japan Cabinet Office / FDMA / Tokyo Fire Dept. earthquake safety guidance) to Chapters 5-6 (which simultaneously fixes the stress-test network vulnerability in FIX-04).

FIX-02: Forbidden Mainland slang '翻車' appears twice (theme.connection: '兩大翻車現場'; theme.chapters[4].new_information: '單押一項神器常翻車'), and Mainland corporate jargon '落地' appears in viewer-facing K153-0216.question ('怎麼落地？'). FIX-03: Defective/ambiguous Chinese multiplier phrasing and missing 【換算】 tags: (1) S08 reading_scope writes '增重兩倍' (+200% = 3x instead of 2x) and K153-0201 answer_target writes '變重兩倍'; (2) S04 summary ('增加約 12 倍'), Ch1 & K153-0203 ('暴增約 12 倍'), and K153-0203 locator ('增 12 倍') misrender PMC408401's '~12-fold increase' (which means rising TO ~12x, not +1200% = 13x); (3) Ch2 & K153-0205 write '【換算】發育速度加快超過八倍' (122/15=8.13x, should state '加快至原來的八倍以上'); (4) missing 【換算】 tags on K153-0216 ('大減逾九成' / '大減約 98%', which also shifts S02's '<51%' to '<50%'), K153-0210.editorial.visual ('過敏原沖掉七成以上', from 100%-26.8%=73.2%), and S07/Ch1/K153-0201 ('合計 50 種真菌', derived from 3 commonest + 47 other species across pillows & vacuum dust). → Correct all Chinese multipliers to unambiguous Taiwan zh-TW ('重量變為兩倍'/'增重一倍', '提高至約 12 倍'/'暴增至約 12 倍', '【換算】發育速度加快至原來的八倍以上'), restore '<51%' in K153-0216 when citing S02, and add explicit 【換算】 tags to K153-0216, K153-0210.editorial.visual, and S07/Ch1/K153-0201 ('常見 3 種與另外 47 種，【換算】合計 50 種，來自枕頭與吸出灰塵').
